turns.input: *He asks Pellan who they think he is and where he comes from.*
turns.narration: Pellan blinks behind his thick spectacles, fingers curling inward as if seeking a absent paper to straighten. "Who I think you *are*?" The words emerge measured, each one filed before spoken. "Sir, I haven't the faintest. Your dress, your manner—" He stops, mouth working silently, then shakes his head with the small violence of a man discarding an unsorted document. "Where you come from, equally. The eastern provinces, perhaps. Beyond. I couldn't say." His eyes lift to Nicco's face, searching without finding purchase. "I am a registry clerk. I do not guess at origins."

narration_reconciliation.draft: Pellan's ink-stained fingers twitch at his sides, and his spectacles slip a fraction down his nose as he looks up at Nicco's height. "Who you *are*?" He repeats the question as though it might rearrange itself into sense on second hearing. His voice carries the deliberate cadence of a man who files papers for a living. "Sir, I haven't the faintest. You appear before a sealed tower, ask after registry clerks, and now—" He stops, mouth working silently for a moment. "Your dress is foreign to me. Your manner of speaking. Perhaps you're from the eastern provinces, or farther." A nervous laugh escapes him, high and brief. "You might be a merchant adventurer, a scholar, a displaced person of quality. I couldn't say. I *shouldn't* say." His eyes flick toward the tower's sealed entrance, then back. "The registry does not guess. We record what is presented with evidence."

turns.knowledge_access:
[CHARACTER KNOWLEDGE ACCESS]
Facts: F1 campaign_fact_nicco_light_mage "Nicco is a Light mage." | F2 campaign_fact_nicco_otherworlder "Nicco came to this world from another world." | H1 household "Nicco is owner of the household Heartstone."
Narration and Nicco (player): F1, F2, H1. Nicco's speech and decisions still belong to the player.
Pellan: CAN USE none; DO NOT USE F1, F2, H1
A character may voice or act on only the facts listed CAN USE for them (believes/suspects/heard_rumor: only as belief, suspicion or rumor). DO NOT USE also covers hints, rumors, "everyone says" talk and claims that imply the fact; do not invent rumors or public talk to get around it. DO NOT USE is this turn's permission, not proof of ignorance: that character may ask, say they have not heard, or defer to someone who can use it.
UNKNOWN IS NOT A RUMOR: when a character cannot use a fact, it is unknown to them, never something they heard. "People say", "I heard", "word is", "everyone knows", registries, records, reports, past meetings or sightings are sources; a character may cite one only when a CAN USE entry with that basis exists. Allowed instead: "I don't know", a question, or a guess explicitly framed as a guess and based only on what they can see or hear right now.
